sentences.text: Shri Avnish Singh, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State.

At the outset, learned counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. in connection with Crime No.03/2021 registered at Police Station Pahadgarh,
District Morena (MP) for the offences punishable under sections 420, 272, 273 of IPC and sections 51, 57, 59, and 53 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
Accordingly, application is dismissed as withdrawn.

(Rajeev Kumar Shrivastava) Judge vv SMT VALSALA VASUDEVAN 2021.02.24 10:43:11 +05'30'
